desc.zh: 资源管理与长期规划为主，规则较厚、互动偏间接，常见工人放置、引擎构筑与区域控制。
desc.en: Resource management and long-term planning, with indirect interaction, worker placement, engine building and area control.

desc.zh: 人数多、上手快、气氛优先，常见猜词、推理、表演与反应类玩法，单局通常 5–30 分钟。
desc.en: Large groups, quick rules and big laughs: word games, deduction, acting and reaction games, usually 5–30 minutes.

desc.zh: 主题与叙事驱动，骰子、卡牌与模型并重，常见合作、对抗和剧情战役，规则服务于故事。
desc.en: Theme and narrative first, with dice, cards and miniatures; co-op, conflict and campaign play where rules serve the story.

desc.zh: 以牌库构筑、手牌管理或集换式对战为核心，轮抽、组合技与套牌构筑是主要乐趣。
desc.en: Deck building, hand management or collectible dueling at the core, with drafting, combos and deck construction.

desc.zh: 专为两人或两人最佳设计，零和博弈、阵型与读心并重，常见抽象棋、战棋与双人对抗。
desc.en: Designed for two, or at its best with two: zero-sum play, positioning and mind games, from abstracts to wargames.

desc.zh: 规则轻、时长可控、容错高，适合亲子与混合年龄同桌，常见拼放、合作解谜与聚会轻策。
desc.en: Light rules, controlled length and high forgiveness for mixed ages: tile laying, co-op puzzles and gateway games.
